items.title: Handling large volume of transactions with AWS Lambda Managed Instances
items.summary: AWS Lambda Managed Instances keeps compute capacity warm before a predictable traffic burst and scales it back down afterward. This post walks through a concert-ticketing reference implementation that sustains 40,000 transactions per second for 120 seconds, with a deployable sample you can run, test, and clean up.
items.creator: Mythili Annamalai Sekar
